title: Ops Lighthouse: curated action templates and safeguarded quickpaths
creator: Ava Patel
description: Build a curated catalog of vetted admin action templates ("Lighthouse" templates) that let first-line support and oncall safely execute common remediation flows with RBAC gating, ephemeral credential injection, and telemetry-driven preflight checks. Aim is to reduce time-to-remediate for common incidents while preserving SLOs and minimizing blast radius. Templates are opinionated: parameterized, idempotent, testable, and annotated with required roles, estimated cost, and risk level.
acceptance_criteria: Create 10 initial Lighthouse templates covering: service restarts, cache invalidation, cold-cache warm-up, model variant fallback, and quota replenishment
Each template includes: human-readable summary, preflight health checks, explicit rollback steps, required permission set, estimated cost tokens, and telemetry KPIs
RBAC gating implemented: templates can only run if caller has explicit 'lighthouse.run' permission and origin is support console or operator CLI
Ephemeral credentials path built: templates inject scoped short-lived tokens and automatically revoke on complete/failure
Dry-run mode implemented and exercised in staging with automated smoke tests for each template
Observability: each run emits structured events (start, preflight, action-step, result, rollback) and a dashboard tile for template success/failure and mean time to completion
Security review completed and signoff from security team
Canary release path: 10% of runs go through a supervised approval flow in the first week post-release
